Sach kya hai?
✅ Spinal ke baad pairon mein harkat lautne mein aam taur par 4 ghante tak lagte hain, poori feeling lautne mein thoda zyada
✅ Sunnpan dheere-dheere jaata hai, jhanjhanahat hona aam hai, aur ek taraf pehle theek ho sakti hai
✅ Pehli baar bed se uthte samay chakkar ya ladkhadahat ho sakti hai, isliye staff ki madad lijiye
✅ Feeling ya harkat umeed ke mutaabik na laute, ya sunnpan/kamzori badhe, toh turant team ko bataiye
